result.summary: The screen is mostly coherent, but the header action control looks broken (empty/low-contrast circle) and the fastest-near-you row clips a restaurant name mid-word.

issues.description: The top-right circular control is visually empty: only a faint gray circle and a red badge are visible, with no icon, avatar, or label. It reads as a failed/missing asset rather than a usable button.
issues.suggestion: Render a clear cart or profile icon inside the circle, increase contrast against the white header, and give the control an accessible name.

issues.description: The last Fastest near you card is clipped by the screen edge so the restaurant name reads as “Trattoria Piccol” with no ellipsis, which looks like broken/truncated text.
issues.suggestion: Either fit ~2.5 cards with a clearer peek, or truncate the visible title with an ellipsis so names are not cut mid-word.

issues.description: The empty header circle is nearly the same color as the background, so the control is easy to miss aside from the red notification dot.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible stroke, stronger fill, or a high-contrast icon so the control is discoverable.
